claim_boundary: U.S. business applications provide timely high-frequency information about entrepreneurial activity, but the weekly series is not seasonally adjusted, is revised and since late 2024 is published with the monthly BFS release. Positive year-over-year growth may identify broad economic risk-taking that supports Bitcoin demand, yet applications need not become operating businesses and can be driven by tax, legal or sector-composition changes. Exactly one preregistered long-or-cash audit may test the positive-growth sign; no causal or alpha claim is imported from the source definition.

feature_contract.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED

prior_matrix.identity: U.S. Census Bureau Business Applications via FRED
prior_matrix.finding: The official series is weekly ending Saturday, percent change from year ago, not seasonally adjusted, sourced from the Census Weekly Business Formation Statistics release and tagged Public Domain: Citation Requested.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: FRED states that all observations are subject to revision; the current-vintage series does not preserve what was first reported at each historical decision time.

prior_matrix.identity: U.S. Census Bureau Business Formation Statistics data tables
prior_matrix.finding: The Census Bureau describes BFS as timely high-frequency information on new business applications and formations; weekly data start in 2006, contain only not-seasonally-adjusted application series, and are currently distributed with the monthly release.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: An EIN application is an intent signal rather than a realized business formation, and current monthly publication makes historical weekly release timing non-uniform.

prior_matrix.identity: U.S. Census Bureau Weekly BFS publication notice
prior_matrix.finding: The Census Bureau states that weekly estimates stopped being published weekly after August 29, 2024 and are now included in the monthly BFS release.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The fixed 45-calendar-day delay is a conservative research convention intended to avoid assuming earlier availability; it is not claimed to reproduce every historical release timestamp.

real_time_design_requirements: Before accessing any historical BUSAPPWNSAUSYY values, freeze a source-feasibility specification for exact FRED CSV identity, Saturday weekly lattice, missing-value handling, both-state support, transitions, annual breadth and concentration.

If the source gate permits continuation, seal exact annual FRED CSV responses from 2017-01-01 through 2024-12-31; reject duplicate, non-Saturday, missing, non-finite or discontinuous weekly observations.
Use only the published year-over-year percent-change series and classify values strictly above zero as supportive; equality belongs to the other state.
Make observation week ending Saturday D usable only at D plus 45 calendar days 00:00 UTC and valid for at most 168 hours, conservatively covering the monthly-publication regime.
Use the same historical BTC corpus, valuation clock, fee, adverse-slippage, cash-yield and capital conventions as the matched buy-and-hold comparator.

Require separate Design and Validation predictive gates before opening matched-capital economics; require return effect, negative-rate effect, drawdown path, annual breadth, support and concentration.

Do not add high-propensity applications, planned-wage applications, corporation applications, levels, sector or state splits, seasonal adjustment, magnitude cutoffs, moving averages, z-scores, alternate delays, direction inversion, fractional sizing, short legs or post-outcome exceptions.

Do not reinterpret the closed labor, liquidity, yield, financial-condition, equity, credit or volatility branches as evidence for this family; entrepreneurial application growth is the only proposed mechanism.
Do not open post-2024 data; any historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and requires separately sealed independent OOS.
uncertainty: Weekly BFS applications are not seasonally adjusted even though the selected FRED transformation is year over year; holiday timing and 52-versus-53-week alignment may still distort comparisons.
Applications are not formations, jobs, revenue or productive investment, so the economic link can be weak or composition-driven.
The present-vintage FRED series contains revisions and historical first-release values remain MISSING_PROOF.
Publication frequency changed during 2024; the fixed 45-day delay is conservative but may reduce relevance and does not reconstruct exact vintage timestamps.
The positive risk-demand interpretation is economically ambiguous and is a preregistered sign, not a conclusion from the official sources.
No historical BUSAPPWNSAUSYY value, BTC outcome, post-2024 observation, candidate, OOS or Trading path was accessed while freezing this prior.
